entries.title: A crewmate runs the tests it wrote ten times before asking to merge
entries.body: When a crewmate adds or edits a test, it runs that test ten times in a row on your computer before it asks you to merge, or three times on each device for a test that runs on phones or tablets, and tells you how many passed. A failure in a test the change wrote is treated as a problem with the change, never as bad luck, so the crewmate fixes it instead of running the checks again.
entries.noPicture: This changes how a crewmate checks its own tests and what it reports, not a view or control.
